modern: Do not hold the opinion of things that the man who wrongs you holds, or the one he wishes you to hold, but look at them as they truly are.
original: Do not have such an opinion of things as he has who does thee wrong, or such as he wishes thee to have, but look at them as they are in truth.
notification: Do not hold the opinion of things that the man who wrongs you holds, or the one he wishes you to hold, but look at them as they truly are.
notification_original: Do not have such an opinion of things as he has who does thee wrong, or such as he wishes thee to have, but look at them as they are in truth.

explained.summary: When someone wrongs you, don’t take on their view of things, or the view they’d like you to have. If they think insulting you makes you smaller, or want you to feel humiliated, you don’t have to agree. Look at what actually happened, as it really is.
explained.today: When someone online calls your opinion stupid, they want you to feel stupid. You can check whether the criticism has any substance and leave the rest, instead of accepting their verdict along with their tone.
